headline: Technical Support Representative
summary: Technical support representative with three years at an internet provider's help desk. I troubleshoot modems, Wi-Fi and account problems by phone and email, and I helped design the support process our team now follows. I understand networks well enough to fix most issues without a site visit.
skills: Support process design and escalation rules

experience.title: Technical Support Representative
bullets: Resolve about 40 support tickets a day on slow connections, Wi-Fi setup and modem faults.
Walk subscribers through router settings and replace faulty units without sending a technician.
Helped write the support tiers and escalation rules when the team grew from 6 to 20.
Teach subscribers to spot fake payment messages and secure their Wi-Fi passwords.

experience.title: Computer Technician
bullets: Repaired laptops and desktops and set up home networks for walk-in customers.
Explained repair options and costs to customers before starting work.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
